description: Use this when the user wants to enable the salon text AI receptionist. Accepts salonId and optional skipTest. Checks access, email verification, existing plan entitlement and operational readiness, then saves a proposed activation and returns its change ID and preview. If the user explicitly declines the optional test, set skipTest=true; otherwise a current successful test is required. Does not enable replies during preparation. After confirmation, beautyos_apply_change applies activation; existing connected channels may then receive automatic replies.
name: beautyos_agent_activate_prepare
title: Preview agent activate
